This morning, he developed acute onset of substernal chest pain, radiating to his left arm. This pain is not relived by rest. The patient last took a sildenafil the night before. Which of the following treatments is absolutely contraindicated in this situation?
question.text: A 51-year-old man is brought to the emergency department for chest pain. The patient has chronic stable angina that is usually precipitated by activity and relived by rest. About 3 weeks ago, his physician prescribed sildenafil (Viagra), and he has been using the drug with success. This morning, he developed acute onset of substernal chest pain, radiating to his left arm. This pain is not relived by rest. The patient last took a sildenafil the night before. extra.html: The co-administration of nitrates within 24 hours after taking sildenafil in absolutely contraindicated. The vasodilatory effects of nitrates are amplified when administered in the presence of sildenafil (Viagra), which can lead to refractory and live-threatening hypotension. Therefore, patients using sildenafil should be instructed to report their use on presentation to any emergency department and to never take nitrates while using the drug.

question.html: What is the most common complication of Infective endocarditis?
question.text: What is the most common complication of Infective endocarditis?

title.text:
صلي الله على محمد
CardioThoracic PRO
Pediatrics::Two

extra.html: Microscopic hematuria is seen in about 50% of cases. Pericardial effusion is widely believed to signify more advanced infective endocarditis and a generally worse outcome. Splenomegaly occurs in 37% of patients with active infective endocarditis and in 64% of those with prosthetic valve endocarditis. Acute stroke is the second most common complication of left-sided infective endocarditis. Congestive heart failure (CHF) is the most common complication of all.

question.html: Which of the following is true about pulmonary embolism treatment?
question.text: Which of the following is true about pulmonary embolism treatment?

title.text:
صلي الله على محمد
CardioThoracic PRO
End_Mod_25_(B)

options.label: A
options.html: a) Unfractionated Heparin dosage is adjusted by prothrombin time (PT) measurement.
options.text: a) Unfractionated Heparin dosage is adjusted by prothrombin time (PT) measurement.

options.label: B
options.html: b) Activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) measurement is the laboratory test commonly used to monitor warfarin
options.text: b) Activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT) measurement is the laboratory test commonly used to monitor warfarin

options.label: C
options.html: c) Thrombolytic therapy indicated in patients with acute pulmonary embolism associated with sustained hypotension.
options.text: c) Thrombolytic therapy indicated in patients with acute pulmonary embolism associated with sustained hypotension.

options.label: D
options.html: d) Thrombolytic therapy indicated in patients with acute pulmonary embolism associated even there is active melena
options.text: d) Thrombolytic therapy indicated in patients with acute pulmonary embolism associated even there is active melena

options.label: E
options.html: e) Protamine sulphate is the treatment of choice for bleeding in patient on warfarin therapy
options.text: e) Protamine sulphate is the treatment of choice for bleeding in patient on warfarin therapy

correct_option_texts: c) Thrombolytic therapy indicated in patients with acute pulmonary embolism associated with sustained hypotension.
